title: Dia Browser privacy
description: A quiet trust panel: a wide box with a dotted outline and small icons notched into its top and bottom edges, a two-line serif heading split by a strip of grey setting chips (mono label, coloured dot, on/off value box) that runs past both edges and drifts sideways as you scroll, then centred grey text and a grey pill link whose arrow nudges right on hover. Fades in on entering view.
notes: the chip strip is repeated three times and clipped by the box; it drifts about 70px across the section's pass (CSS view timeline)
dots alternate the theme's glow and highlight colours
